correctness.rationale: The observer map i->j(i) is a finite loop-free functional digraph: each weak component contains a directed cycle of length >=2. Fixed value at any cycle vertex determines the values throughout the component by traversing inverse repair equations. Processing t components of sizes s_j bounds family size by product_r (n-sum_{h<r}s_h). Even n gives 2^m m!. Odd n forces one size>=3, placed first, and gives n(n-3)(n-5)...2. The construction with a three-letter (r,f(r),g(f(r))) prefix and h-paired suffix realizes equality at all odd lengths, including n=3. Independent n=3,5,7,9,11 construction/repair enumeration obtains 3,10,56,432,4224.
